mcq_fix.s: As per the provisional figures of Census 2011, the child sex ratio (0-6 years) of India was:
mcq_fix.why: 914 is the provisional figure; final Census 2011 CSR is 918

mcq_drop.why: dubious 'first' framing (Art 24 as 'first constitutional protection'); no exam words it so

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: AP current affairs (environment awareness ride)

patterns: APPSC asks direct facts: RTE in force 1 April 2010; free and compulsory education up to 14 as a Fundamental Right; Art 24 child labour wording.
Odd-one-out on RTE features (Centre sole funding is NOT a feature) and NPE priority areas (nutrition education NOT one).
Portal/body naming: e-Baal Nidan = NCPCR grievance portal; UNCRC 54 articles, 20 November.
Trap pairs: 21A (6-14 FR) vs 45 (care till 6) vs 51A(k) (parent's duty); 1993 Unni Krishnan arose from AP.
App has broad coverage incl. adoption portals and Samagra Shiksha; mostly sound, slightly heavier on 'first' and A/R formats.
